\multicolumn{6}{@{}p{\linewidth}@{}}{\footnotesize\raggedright\rule{0pt}{2.5ex}\textit{Notes:} Each series $u$ enters as $u^{(k)}$, its adjusted, transformed and winsorized value averaged over the previous $k$ intervals, and as $\bar a^{(k)}(u)$, the share of those intervals on which it was observed; series with an activity indicator also enter as $\bar\chi^{(k)}(u)$, the share off their mode (the mode and its share of intervals are in the description). $\mathcal K = \{1, 5, 25, 125, 625, 3125\}$ in the closing-interval model and $\{1, 2, 4, \dots, 2048\}$ in the pooled intraday model, which omits the FOMC group. Periodicity adjustment: division by the trailing same-interval mean (mean) or standard deviation (s.d.); $g$: the variance-stabilizing map; the volatility-demand series take $\operatorname{asinh}(u_{t,i} / \kappa_{t,i})$ in place of both (Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}). A series is signed if it has any negative value: $\mathrm{Spread}^{\mathrm{VW}}$ has a single negative value (2018-11-12 11:00 ET) and so takes $g(v) = v$ and the s.d.\ adjustment, where $\mathrm{Spread}^{\mathrm{EW}}$ takes $\log v$ and the mean. Unnormalized and unscaled: without the factors $\sqrt{N_{t,i}} / \RV_{t,i}^{3/2}$ (skewness), $N_{t,i}/3$ (quarticity) and $\pi/2$ (bipower variation).}\\
\endlastfoot
\multicolumn{6}{@{}l}{\textit{Realized moments (7)}} \\
$r$ & Interval log return, $r_{t,i} = \sum_k r_{t,i,k}$ & ES futures & s.d. & $v$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret
$\mathrm{RAV}$ & Realized absolute variation, $\sum_k |r_{t,i,k}|$ & ES futures & mean & $v$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumabsret
$\mathrm{RSK}$ & Realized skewness, unnormalized, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^3$ & ES futures & s.d. & $v^{1/3}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret3
$\mathrm{RQ}$ & Realized quarticity, unscaled, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^4$ & ES futures & mean & $\sign(v)\,|v|^{1/4}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret4
$\mathrm{RS}^{+}$ & Positive realized semivariance, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^2\,\mathbf{1}\{r_{t,i,k} > 0\}$ & ES futures & mean & $\sqrt{v}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumpret2
$\mathrm{BV}$ & Bipower variation, $\mathrm{BV}_{t,i} = \sum_{k \ge 2} |r_{t,i,k}|\,|r_{t,i,k-1}|$ & ES futures & mean & $\sqrt{v}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumbipow
$\mathrm{AC}$ & First-order realized autocovariance, $\mathrm{AC}_{t,i} = \sum_{k \ge 2} r_{t,i,k}\, r_{t,i,k-1}$ & ES futures & s.d. & $\sign(v)\,|v|^{1/2}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumautocov
